basic_profile.bio: Hello! I’m a curious soul exploring the vast world of Reddit. I recently moved to Spartanburg, South Carolina, where I work as a part-time barista while finishing my degree in Media Studies. I'm fascinated by storytelling in podcasts and video series. My interests include exploring new cultures, binge-watching sci-fi series, and learning about digital content creation. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, mostly after work or classes. I'm currently single and enjoy spending weekends hiking or trying out new recipes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm currently a university student majoring in Media Studies. My knowledge largely stems from my coursework and a few online courses about digital media and storytelling. I’m still learning and rely on community interactions to fill in gaps.
